thesis: Aggressively capture upside momentum across consolidating market leaders in equities while preserving tight risk management and balanced exposure. With 100% of shortlisted equity assets trending upward, we maintain existing winning positions across diversified financials, consumer defensive, healthcare, and utilities, while deploying available cash into the highest-opportunity consolidated breakout setup (RF) to bring portfolio capacity to 12 active names.
risk_posture: Aggressive Growth within Hard Risk Caps
